correctness.rationale: The 18-state binary summand-carry automaton represents precisely nonnegative x+y=n with both summand weights congruent c modulo three; a separate three-state tracker handles single summands. An explicit finite NFA recognizes each candidate exception formula. Exhaustive BFS of all reachable product subset states (108,108,107) checks exact agreement on every canonical positive binary word; zero separately checked. This is an infinite regular-language proof using finite exhaustive abstract states, not extrapolation from 10000 directly checked integers. Source code, assertions and verification are included.
